title: #10373 Fix Sales Cr.Memo - PEPPOL30 XSD scheme validity
summary: The Sales Credit Memo PEPPOL30 XMLport now exports the TaxPointDate element in the correct position within the XML structure to comply with the PEPPOL UBL CreditNote schema specification.
key_points: TaxPointDate element repositioned to appear after IssueDate in the XML output
Aligns the XMLport structure with PEPPOL BIS3 CreditNote XSD requirements
Fixes validation failures when TaxPointDate has a populated value
Affects custom implementations of the PEPPOL Document Info Provider interface
